title: valid-signature-mistaken-for-commitment-authority

proposition.statement: A valid signature or authenticated agent identity must not be treated as proof that the principal authorized the exact material commitment.

preconditions: The actor can authenticate and produce a valid signature.
A material commitment is presented for reliance.
Action-specific principal-derived authority has not been established.

trigger.statement: The relying system accepts the commitment because the message signature verifies.

evidence_required.statement: Evidence of the principal-derived mandate or authority applicable to the exact action.
Evidence binding the signature to the exact action, without treating signature validity as authorization.
The policy that determines action-specific commitment authority.

falsification.condition: The system returns PASS solely because the signature or actor identity verifies.
The system cannot establish the mandate but converts the missing evidence into PASS.
